title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
title_zh: Connected Self Forcing：超越视频自回归中的局部学习

paragraphs.en: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure. Additional materials on the project page .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时流式传输长视频，Self Forcing 通过在自生成的历史数据上进行自展开训练，并结合键值（KV）缓存来缓解暴露偏差。 为保持内存可控，该方法会分离历史缓存，保留各片段之间的前向依赖关系，但切断后向梯度路径。 我们提出了 Connected Self Forcing，一种训练框架，它重新连接自回归片段之间的梯度路径，使后续预测的反馈能够指导早期上下文的生成方式。 这些连接超越了历史 KV 的写入：梯度通过生成的潜在变量传递至产生这些变量的计算过程，从而将早期上下文的生成与其在后续预测中的使用联系起来。 为使这种关联训练具备内存效率，我们开发了快捷梯度重播方法，它无需保留完整的展开计算图即可恢复跨片段的梯度。 Connected Self Forcing 与分布匹配蒸馏相结合，使历史片段既能根据直接监督进行训练，也能根据其后续生成中的贡献度进行训练。 在自回归视频生成上的实验表明，该方法提升了长时程的视觉质量和时间一致性，且无需改变推理流程。 项目页面提供补充材料。

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation has advanced rapidly in visual fidelity, motion realism, and text–video alignment ( Team et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ) , with growing applications ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Yet many high-quality models still rely on finite-window bidirectional processing, making them less suitable for streaming, interactive, and long-horizon generation. Causal autoregressive generation offers a natural alternative by generating frames or chunks sequentially from previously generated context, and has therefore been increasingly explored for long-form video generation and interactive world modeling ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成技术在视觉保真度、动作真实感以及文本与视频的同步性方面取得了快速进步（Team 等，2025；Seedance 等，2026；MiniMax，2026），其应用也日益广泛（Liang 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026a；Jiang 等，2025）。 然而，许多高质量模型仍然依赖有限窗口的双向处理机制，这使得它们不太适合流式、交互式以及长时程的生成任务。 因果自回归生成提供了一种自然的替代方案：它基于先前生成的上下文依次生成帧或片段，因此被越来越多地用于长视频生成和交互式世界建模（Yin 等，2025；Valevski 等，2025；Huang 等，2025b；Zheng 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Training causal video generators, however, faces a mismatch between training and inference: teacher forcing relies on ground-truth history, while Diffusion Forcing improves robustness by exposing the model to noisy histories ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025c ) goes further by directly training on the model’s own autoregressive rollouts, better aligning training with inference. To keep such sequential self-rollout tractable, however, previously generated history is detached when reused by later chunks.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，训练因果视频生成器面临着训练与推理之间的不匹配问题：教师强制依赖真实历史数据，而扩散强制则通过让模型接触含噪声的历史数据来提高其鲁棒性（Chen 等人，2024a）。 自我强制（Huang 等人，2025c）更进一步，直接以模型自身的自回归生成序列作为训练数据，从而更好地使训练与推理保持一致。 然而，为了使这种顺序的自我生成过程具有可行性，先前生成的历史数据在后续片段中重复使用时会被解耦。

paragraphs.en: Each generated chunk in an autoregressive rollout serves as both an output and causal context for later predictions. Self Forcing applies a video-level DMD objective to the generated rollout, giving every chunk a direct output gradient ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . However, detaching reused history blocks gradients from later predictions through historical KV states to the computation that generated earlier chunks. The forward dependency remains, but this backward path is absent (Fig. 1 ). To isolate this effect, we use a simplified 1D Gaussian autoregressive toy experiment (Fig. 2 ). Although far simpler than video generation, it shows SF’s long-horizon validation error leveling off while CSF continues improving toward Full BPTT. CSF also approaches Full BPTT’s final rollout accuracy beyond the training horizon. These observations motivate the use of future-to-history gradients without retaining the full rollout graph.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归展开中生成的每个片段既是输出，也是后续预测的因果上下文。 自我强制（Self Forcing）将视频级别的 DMD 目标应用于生成的展开序列，使每个片段都获得直接的输出梯度（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a）。 然而，通过历史 KV 状态将重复使用的历史块与后续预测的梯度从生成早期片段的计算过程中分离开来。 前向依赖仍然存在，但这一反向路径并不存在（图 1）。 为了隔离这种效应，我们使用一个简化的单维高斯自回归玩具实验（图 2）。 尽管比视频生成简单得多，但该实验表明：自我强制（SF）的长期验证误差趋于稳定，而连续自我强制（CSF）则持续改进，最终接近完整 BPTT（Full BPTT）的表现。 CSF 在超出训练时间范围后，其最终展开准确率也接近完整 BPTT 的水平。 这些观察结果促使我们在不保留完整展开图的情况下，使用从未来到历史的梯度。

sents.zh: CSF 在超出训练时间范围后，其最终展开准确率也接近完整 BPTT 的水平。

sents.en: These observations motivate the use of future-to-history gradients without retaining the full rollout graph.
sents.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们在不保留完整展开图的情况下，使用从未来到历史的梯度。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we introduce Connected Self Forcing (CSF), which restores future-to-history gradient flow without retaining the full autoregressive computation graph. CSF retains the detached self-rollout of Self Forcing and introduces Shortcut Gradient Replay. CSF recovers selected cross-chunk derivative paths rather than the full-sequence gradient. Specifically, a later chunk is replayed with its historical KV states treated as differentiable, allowing the downstream gradient to propagate through the KV-writing process and back to the earlier chunk that produced those states. By replaying only the required computations rather than backpropagating through the entire rollout, CSF trades recomputation for substantially lower activation memory. Importantly, CSF adds no model parameters and leaves inference unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 受这些观察的启发，我们提出了“连接自强化”（Connected Self Forcing，CSF），它无需保留完整的自回归计算图，即可恢复从未来到历史的梯度流。 CSF保留了“自强化”中解耦的自我展开机制，并引入了“捷径梯度重播”。 CSF恢复的是选定的跨块导数路径，而非整个序列的梯度。 具体来说，一个较晚的块会与其历史KV状态一起被重播，而这些历史KV状态被视为可微的，从而使得下游梯度能够通过KV写入过程反向传播到生成这些状态的早期块。 由于CSF仅重播必要的计算，而非在整个展开过程中进行反向传播，因此它以重新计算为代价，显著降低了激活内存的占用。 重要的是，CSF不会增加任何模型参数，也不会改变推理过程。

paragraphs.en: Experiments show that CSF improves long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency. The improvements are reflected in better imaging quality and stronger background and subject consistency, while qualitative results show reduced subject and scene drift over extended rollouts (Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，CSF 能够提升长期视觉质量与时间一致性。 这些改进体现在更优的成像质量以及更强的背景和主体一致性上，而定性结果则显示，在长时间运行过程中，主体和场景的漂移得到了减少（图 1）。

sents.en: Experiments show that CSF improves long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency.
sents.zh: 实验表明，CSF 能够提升长期视觉质量与时间一致性。

sents.en: The improvements are reflected in better imaging quality and stronger background and subject consistency, while qualitative results show reduced subject and scene drift over extended rollouts (Fig. 1 ).
sents.zh: 这些改进体现在更优的成像质量以及更强的背景和主体一致性上，而定性结果则显示，在长时间运行过程中，主体和场景的漂移得到了减少（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1) We identify a forward–backward gap in Self Forcing: generated chunks affect future predictions in the forward rollout, while detachment blocks gradient paths from later generation computations into earlier context generation. 2) We propose Connected Self Forcing (CSF) with Shortcut Gradient Replay, reconnecting cross-chunk gradient paths beyond the direct output gradients of DMD, without retaining the full computation graph or changing inference. 3) We demonstrate improved long-horizon generation across 60- and 240-second evaluations, with stronger visual quality and temporal consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献如下：1）我们发现了自我强制（Self Forcing）中存在的前向–后向差异：生成的片段会影响前向展开中的未来预测，而解耦则阻断了后续生成计算与早期上下文生成之间的梯度路径。2）我们提出了带快捷梯度重放的连接自我强制（Connected Self Forcing, CSF），该方法在无需保留完整计算图或改变推理过程的前提下，重新连接了 DMD 直接输出梯度之外的跨片段梯度路径。3）我们在 60 秒和 240 秒的评估中展示了更优的长时程生成效果，包括更强的视觉质量和时间一致性。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional video generation. Video generation has evolved from early diffusion extensions of image models to large-scale foundation models ( Ho et al., 2022b ; Blattmann et al., 2023b ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2025 ) . VideoLDM ( Blattmann et al., 2023b ) extends pretrained latent diffusion with temporal modeling for video generation. Other early works explore image–video priors, motion modules, and decomposed noise modeling ( Ho et al., 2022b ; Singer et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , while hierarchical and cascaded designs extend temporal range and spatial resolution ( Ho et al., 2022a ; He et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Lumiere ( Bar-Tal et al., 2024 ) instead generates the full temporal duration in a single Space-Time U-Net pass. More recent systems explore improved conditioning, transformer architectures, and large-scale data and model scaling ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Blattmann et al., 2023a ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Gupta et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2025 ) . Such bidirectional computation remains less suitable for low-latency streaming ( Yin et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 双向视频生成。 视频生成已从早期图像模型的扩散模型扩展，发展为大规模基础模型（Ho et al., 2022b；Blattmann et al., 2023b；Polyak et al., 2024；Team et al., 2025）。 VideoLDM（Blattmann et al., 2023b）通过引入时间建模，将预训练的潜在扩散模型扩展至视频生成领域。 其他早期研究探索了图像-视频先验、运动模块和分解噪声建模（Ho et al., 2022b；Singer et al., 2022；Guo et al., 2023；Luo et al., 2023），而分层和级联设计则扩展了时间范围和空间分辨率（Ho et al., 2022a；He et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 相比之下，Lumiere（Bar-Tal et al., 2024）通过单次时空U-Net处理生成完整的时间序列。 更近期的系统则探索了改进的条件输入、Transformer架构以及大规模数据和模型扩展（Chen et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2024b；Blattmann et al., 2023a；Ma et al., 2024；Gupta et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025；Kong et al., 2024；Polyak et al., 2024；Team et al., 2025）。 此类双向计算在低延迟流媒体场景中仍不太适用（Yin et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video generation. Autoregressive models generate frames or chunks from prior generated content ( Huang et al., 2025c ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Earlier approaches model tokenized video with transformers ( Yan et al., 2021 ; Ge et al., 2022 ; Hong et al., 2022 ) ; VideoPoet ( Kondratyuk et al., 2023 ) extends decoder-only autoregression to multimodal generation, while Phenaki ( Villegas et al., 2022 ) combines a causal tokenizer with masked-token prediction. Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024a ) generalizes causal sequence modeling to independently noised continuous tokens. Recent approaches use increasing per-chunk noise ( Teng et al., 2025 ) , Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , or temporal-pyramid history compression ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . Few-step generation builds on progressive distillation, consistency models, and distribution matching ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) ; CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) extends distribution matching to few-step causal video generation.

paragraphs.en: Train–test mismatch has motivated scheduled sampling and Professor Forcing ( Bengio et al., 2015 ; Lamb et al., 2016 ) . Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025c ) directly trains on self-generated history with a video-level objective, while gradient truncation keeps training tractable. Subsequent works improve few-step causal initialization ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) and long-horizon training ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 训练与测试之间的不匹配问题推动了计划采样和教授强制法（Bengio 等人，2015；Lamb 等人，2016）的发展。 自我强制法（Huang 等人，2025c）直接在自生成的历史数据上进行训练，并使用视频级目标函数，而梯度截断则使训练过程保持可行。 后续研究改进了少数步因果初始化（Zhu 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026a）和长时程训练（Liu 等人，2026；Cui 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent with our work, Self Gradient Forcing ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) uses future losses to train context KV memory writing while keeping generated context stop-gradient, whereas Vidu S2’s Self-Replay Forcing ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) enables cross-block gradients within a differentiable replay of re-noised self-generated trajectories. Our method instead reconnects cross-chunk gradient paths through historical KV writing and earlier-chunk generation via Shortcut Gradient Replay.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们的研究同步，Self Gradient Forcing（Zhuang 等人，2026）利用未来损失来训练上下文 KV 内存的写入过程，同时保持生成上下文的梯度停止；而 Vidu S2 的 Self-Replay Forcing（Zhang 等人，2026b）则在一个可微分的重噪声自生成轨迹的重播过程中实现了跨块的梯度传播。 相比之下，我们的方法通过历史 KV 写入和早期块生成，借助 Shortcut Gradient Replay 重新连接了跨分块的梯度路径。

paragraphs.en: History modeling for long video generation. Long-video generation also requires useful history under bounded context. Training-free extensions use temporal co-denoising, noise rescheduling with windowed attention, and global/local spectral blending ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) . FIFO-Diffusion ( Kim et al., 2024 ) performs diagonal queue-based denoising, RIFLEx ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) adjusts positional-embedding frequency to suppress repetition, and Ouroboros-Diffusion ( Chen et al., 2025b ) combines cross-frame attention and recurrent guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 长视频生成的历史建模。 长视频生成在上下文受限的情况下也需要有用的历史信息。 无需训练的扩展方法利用时间协同去噪、基于窗口注意力的噪声重调度，以及全局/局部频谱混合（Wang 等，2023；Qiu 等，2024；Lu 等，2024）。 FIFO-Diffusion（Kim 等，2024）采用对角队列式去噪，RIFLEx（Zhao 等，2025）通过调整位置嵌入频率来抑制重复，而 Ouroboros-Diffusion（Chen 等，2025b）则结合了跨帧注意力和循环引导。

paragraphs.en: Memory mechanisms preserve or retrieve context through previous-chunk attention, frame sinks with KV recaching, importance-based allocation, and long-context teacher supervision ( Henschel et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . More structured designs include geometry-indexed memory, role-based memory decomposition, distant-history retrieval, and gated recall ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . Ring Forcing ( Xue et al., 2026 ) enforces distant-history retrieval via ring training and scales memory with compression and sparse RoPE.

paragraphs.en: Other methods modify temporal supervision and guidance. History-Guided Video Diffusion ( Song et al., 2025 ) supports flexible history conditioning; LongVie ( Gao et al., 2025a ) improves cross-clip control and consistency, with LongVie 2 ( Gao et al., 2025b ) adding history-context guidance. Video-Mirai ( Yu et al., 2026 ) distills future-aware features from a frozen non-causal foresight encoder into causal states, whereas Next Forcing ( Xu et al., 2026 ) adds predictors over multiple future horizons. CSF instead propagates gradients from later-chunk losses into earlier context generation.

paragraphs.en: In autoregressive generation, each historical chunk plays two roles: it is both a generated output and part of the causal context for subsequent predictions. sents.en: In parallel, the KV-writing replay can propagate its incoming KV gradient to earlier KV writers while keeping each writer’s generated-latent input detached, preventing this writer-only feedback from re-entering earlier generation branches.

sents.en: We call this procedure Shortcut Gradient Replay , as it directly connects later predictions to selected historical chunks without recursively replaying the intervening generation trajectory.

paragraphs.en: Connected Self Forcing modifies only the generator-side gradient propagation during training. The real-score model remains fixed, while the fake-score model is updated with the standard DMD denoising objective and does not require gradient replay. The method introduces no additional model parameters. At inference time, all replay operations are removed, and the generator follows the same causal autoregressive rollout and KV-cache mechanism as the original Self Forcing model.

paragraphs.en: Training Details. We perform text-to-video DMD post-training using the released filtered and extended VidProM prompt set ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) , without loading additional real videos during this stage. Our main experiments use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Team et al., 2025 ) as the causal generator. Following Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025c ) , we optimize the generator with DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , using a frozen Wan2.1-T2V-14B real-score model and a trainable Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B fake-score model. We use four denoising steps and primarily study chunk-wise generation, where each 21-latent-frame training sequence is divided into seven chunks. Training uses AdamW with a global batch size of 8 for 1,200 iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 训练细节。 我们使用已发布的过滤并扩展的 VidProM 提示词集（Wang and Yang, 2024），在文本到视频 DMD 后训练阶段执行训练，且在此阶段不加载额外的真实视频。 我们的主要实验使用 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B（Team et al., 2025）作为因果生成器。 遵循 Self Forcing（Huang et al., 2025c），我们使用 DMD（Yin et al., 2024b; Yin et al., 2024a）优化生成器，其中采用一个冻结的 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 真实评分模型和一个可训练的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 虚假评分模型。 我们使用四个去噪步骤，并主要研究分块生成方法，其中每个包含 21 个潜在帧的训练序列被划分为七个块。 训练过程中使用 AdamW 优化器，全局批量大小为 8，迭代次数为 1,200 次。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Protocol. For long-horizon evaluation, we generate approximately 60-second videos from 40 VBench-Long prompts ( Huang et al., 2025d ) and approximately 240-second videos from a fixed 128-prompt subset of Movie Gen Video Bench ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate the EMA generator checkpoints with matched four-step causal sampling, inference seeds, resolution, and KV-cache configurations. Following VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2025d ) , we report seven quality and temporal dimensions: aesthetic quality, background consistency, dynamic degree, imaging quality, motion smoothness, subject consistency, and temporal flickering. Further implementation and evaluation details are provided in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Connected Self Forcing (CSF) to address missing future-to-history gradient flow in autoregressive self-rollout training. Its Shortcut Gradient Replay reconnects downstream supervision to historical generation without retaining the full autoregressive computation graph or changing inference. Across several initializations, CSF consistently improves long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency in 60- and 240-second autoregressive videos. By extending gradient flow beyond detached chunk boundaries, CSF highlights the potential of future-aware training for autoregressive video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了“连通自我强制”（Connected Self Forcing，CSF）方法，以解决自回归自我展开训练中未来到历史的梯度流缺失问题。 其“捷径梯度重播”机制无需保留完整的自回归计算图或改变推理过程，即可将下游的监督信号重新连接到历史生成过程。 在多种初始化设置下，CSF 始终能提升 60 秒和 240 秒自回归视频中长时段的视觉质量与时间一致性。 通过将梯度流延伸至脱离的片段边界之外，CSF 凸显了未来感知训练在自回归视频生成中的潜力。

paragraphs.en: For long-video generation, we use a bounded streaming KV cache and keep the temporal positions within the 21-latent-frame range used during training. In the chunk-wise setting, the cache contains a three-frame persistent sink, six recent historical latent frames, and the current three-frame chunk, for a maximum of 12 latent frames. Temporal positions are assigned using the top-aligned cache layout. All compared methods use identical cache geometry and generation seeds. We use a base seed of 42 and assign each generated sample a deterministic seed according to its prompt/sample ordinal.
paragraphs.zh: 对于长视频生成，我们使用有界流式 KV 缓存，并将时间位置限制在训练期间使用的 21 个潜在帧范围内。 在分块设置中，缓存包含一个三帧的持久化接收器、六个最近的过往潜在帧以及当前的三帧块，最多可容纳 12 个潜在帧。 时间位置通过顶部对齐的缓存布局进行分配。 所有对比方法均使用相同的缓存结构和生成种子。 我们使用基础种子 42，并根据每个样本的提示/样本序号为其分配一个确定性种子。

paragraphs.en: Short-video evaluation. For approximately 5-second generation, we use the standard VBench evaluation pipeline ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . We generate five samples for each of the 944 unique prompts in the official metadata, resulting in 4,720 videos. A frozen manifest explicitly maps each generated video back to the corresponding VBench metadata entry, resolving duplicated prompts and filename ambiguity without modifying the underlying VBench scorers. For consistency with our long-horizon evaluation, we primarily report the same seven dimensions used for 60-second and 240-second videos.
paragraphs.zh: 短视频评估。 对于约 5 秒的生成，我们使用标准的 VBench 评估流程（Huang 等人，2024）。 我们为官方元数据中 944 个唯一提示中的每一个生成五个样本，从而得到 4,720 个视频。 一个固定的清单明确地将每个生成的视频映射回对应的 VBench 元数据条目，从而在不修改底层 VBench 评分器的情况下解决了重复提示和文件名歧义的问题。 为了与我们的长期评估保持一致，我们主要报告与 60 秒和 240 秒视频所用相同的七个维度。

paragraphs.en: Long-video evaluation. For approximately 60-second and 240-second generation, we use the VBench-Long implementation in VBench++ ( Huang et al., 2025d ) under a controlled custom-input protocol. We disable semantic scene splitting and divide every generated video into fixed 2-second clips. We report seven dimensions: aesthetic quality, background consistency, dynamic degree, imaging quality, motion smoothness, subject consistency, and temporal flickering. Temporal flickering is evaluated over all clips without static filtering. An explicit manifest maps every clip to its source video, and clip-level scores are aggregated within each source video before averaging across videos, following the VBench-Long aggregation. Subject and background consistency retain the VBench-Long cross-clip comparisons and fuse them with within-clip scores by source video.
paragraphs.zh: 长视频评估。 对于约 60 秒和 240 秒的视频生成，我们在受控的自定义输入协议下使用 VBench++ 中的 VBench-Long 实现（Huang 等人，2025d）。 我们禁用语义场景分割，并将每个生成的视频划分为固定的 2 秒片段。 我们报告七个维度：美学质量、背景一致性、动态程度、成像质量、运动流畅性、主体一致性和时间闪烁。 时间闪烁在所有片段上进行评估，且不使用静态过滤。 一个显式映射表将每个片段与其源视频关联，并遵循 VBench-Long 的聚合方式，先在各源视频内对片段级分数进行汇总，再跨视频计算平均值。 主体和背景一致性保留 VBench-Long 的跨片段比较，并通过源视频将其与片段内分数融合。

paragraphs.en: We further detail the practical implementation of Shortcut Gradient Replay beyond the algorithmic description in the main paper. During the detached self-rollout, we store only the states required to reconstruct the local generation and KV-writing computations, including the sampled exit input and timestep, generated latent, and corresponding causal cache states. The DMD output gradients are computed once after the rollout and reused throughout replay; the recorded stochastic-exit states are also reused rather than resampled.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在主论文中的算法描述之外，进一步详细说明了 Shortcut Gradient Replay 的实际实现。 在分离式自我展开过程中，我们仅存储用于重建局部生成和 KV 写入计算所需的状态，包括采样出的退出输入和时间步长、生成的潜在变量以及对应的因果缓存状态。 DMD 输出梯度在展开后计算一次，并在整个重播过程中重复使用；记录下来的随机退出状态也重复使用，而非重新采样。

paragraphs.en: Replay is implemented as a single reverse traversal over the autoregressive chunks. When processing chunk i i , gradients contributed by later chunks to its KV state have already been accumulated. The required generation and KV-writing VJPs are evaluated through separate forward–backward calls, with each temporary computation graph released immediately after gradient accumulation. Thus, CSF reconstructs only the required local gradient paths without materializing the full autoregressive computation graph.
paragraphs.zh: 重播通过一次对自回归分块的逆向遍历来实现。 在处理分块 i 时，后续分块对其 KV 状态所贡献的梯度已经累积完毕。 所需的生成和 KV 写入 VJP 通过独立的正向-反向调用进行评估，每次临时计算图在梯度累积后立即释放。 因此，CSF 仅重建所需的局部梯度路径，而无需显式构建完整的自回归计算图。

paragraphs.en: We present a simple toy experiment to motivate our study of cross-step gradient propagation. This simplified setting provides intuition about its potential benefits, but the observed behavior need not carry over to real-world video generation. We compare SF, CSF, and Full BPTT under matched architectures, initialization, sampling, and neural DMD training, varying the backward paths through generated history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一个简单的玩具实验，以说明我们对跨步梯度传播的研究动机。 这种简化设定有助于直观理解其潜在优势，但观察到的行为未必能直接迁移到真实世界的视频生成中。 我们在架构、初始化、采样和神经 DMD 训练均保持一致的条件下，比较了 SF、CSF 和 Full BPTT 在通过生成历史进行反向传播时的表现差异。

paragraphs.en: States start at zero, followed by a 96-step burn-in. We retain 2,400 training sequences of length 128 and standardize observations using statistics from their first 24 positions. Each rollout starts from four observed positions and their external inputs. At step j j , the generator receives the current u j u_{j} , generated history, and fresh sampling noise, without future target observations or later external inputs. Given the observed context and subsequent external inputs, the target continuation is deterministic, making paired rollout MSE a direct prediction-error metric.

paragraphs.en: Training. Training proceeds in four stages. We first pretrain a bidirectional flow-matching teacher for 12,000 updates and freeze it. We initialize the causal generator with 5,000 updates of teacher-forcing flow matching using ground-truth history. With the generator fixed, we warm up a bidirectional fake model for 3,000 updates on generated samples. From these shared states, SF, CSF, and Full BPTT each receive 500 neural DMD generator updates, each preceded by five fake-model updates; MSE is reserved for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 训练。 训练分为四个阶段进行。 我们首先对双向流匹配教师模型进行 12,000 次更新的前训练，然后将其冻结。 我们使用真实历史数据，通过教师强制流匹配对因果生成器进行 5,000 次初始化更新。 在固定生成器后，我们对双向虚假模型在生成的样本上进行 3,000 次预热更新。 基于这些共享状态，SF、CSF 和 Full BPTT 各自接收 500 次神经 DMD 生成器更新，每次更新前均进行五次虚假模型更新；MSE 则保留用于评估。

sents.zh: 在固定生成器后，我们对双向虚假模型在生成的样本上进行 3,000 次预热更新。

sents.en: From these shared states, SF, CSF, and Full BPTT each receive 500 neural DMD generator updates, each preceded by five fake-model updates; MSE is reserved for evaluation.
sents.zh: 基于这些共享状态，SF、CSF 和 Full BPTT 各自接收 500 次神经 DMD 生成器更新，每次更新前均进行五次虚假模型更新；MSE 则保留用于评估。

paragraphs.en: The generator shares parameters between velocity prediction and clean KV writing, using one denoising step per autoregressive position in training and inference. To reduce gradient variance from random re-noising, we average the DMD update signal over eight independent re-noising draws of the same generated sequence. SF detaches generated history; CSF reconnects selected history paths through shortcut replay; Full BPTT backpropagates through all 20 autoregressive positions. All methods detach the observed context. We evaluate every endpoint checkpoint across ten paired seeds with shared minibatch and noise streams. Table 4 lists the configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 该生成器在速度预测和干净 KV 写入之间共享参数，在训练和推理阶段，每个自回归位置仅使用一次去噪步骤。 为减少随机重新去噪带来的梯度方差，我们对同一生成序列的八次独立重新去噪采样结果进行 DMD 更新信号的平均。 SF 会断开生成的历史；CSF 通过捷径重播重新连接选定的历史路径；Full BPTT 则通过全部 20 个自回归位置进行反向传播。 所有方法都会断开观测到的上下文。 我们在共享的小批量和噪声流上，使用十个成对的种子对每个终点检查点进行评估。 表 4 列出了相关配置。

paragraphs.en: We profile SF, replay-based full backpropagation through the autoregressive rollout (Full BPTT), and CSF. Each uses eight processes (one GPU and batch size one per process), BF16, hybrid-full FSDP, gradient checkpointing, and matched allocator and cache-release settings. The chunk-wise test follows our main rollout configuration; the frame-wise stress test uses 21 autoregressive latent steps with a nine-latent local history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 SF、基于重放的完整反向传播通过自回归展开（Full BPTT）以及 CSF 进行了剖析。 每种方法均使用八个进程（每个进程一个 GPU 和一批大小为 1 的数据）、BF16、混合完整 FSDP、梯度检查点机制，以及匹配的分配器和缓存释放设置。 按分块进行的测试遵循我们的主要展开配置；按帧进行的压力测试则使用 21 个自回归潜在步长和包含九个潜在值的局部历史。

sents.en: We profile SF, replay-based full backpropagation through the autoregressive rollout (Full BPTT), and CSF.
sents.zh: 我们对 SF、基于重放的完整反向传播通过自回归展开（Full BPTT）以及 CSF 进行了剖析。

sents.en: Each uses eight processes (one GPU and batch size one per process), BF16, hybrid-full FSDP, gradient checkpointing, and matched allocator and cache-release settings.
sents.zh: 每种方法均使用八个进程（每个进程一个 GPU 和一批大小为 1 的数据）、BF16、混合完整 FSDP、梯度检查点机制，以及匹配的分配器和缓存释放设置。

sents.en: The chunk-wise test follows our main rollout configuration; the frame-wise stress test uses 21 autoregressive latent steps with a nine-latent local history.
sents.zh: 按分块进行的测试遵循我们的主要展开配置；按帧进行的压力测试则使用 21 个自回归潜在步长和包含九个潜在值的局部历史。

paragraphs.en: For a controlled comparison, all methods execute the complete four-step denoising rollout. For each video on each GPU, we independently sample one denoising step as the gradient-enabled exit step and use the same exit step for all autoregressive units in that video; the remaining denoising steps do not contribute generator gradients. For Full BPTT, we first record the complete rollout without autograd, and then replay the selected denoising step together with the KV-writing transition for each autoregressive unit under autograd, while retaining the full historical computation graph across the rollout. This allows the gradient signals from later autoregressive units to propagate through the connected historical KV states in a single backward pass.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行受控比较，所有方法都会执行完整的四步去噪流程。 对于每个 GPU 上的每个视频，我们独立地采样一个去噪步骤作为启用梯度的退出步骤，并在该视频的所有自回归单元中使用相同的退出步骤；其余的去噪步骤不会为生成器贡献梯度。 对于完整 BPTT，我们首先在没有自动微分的情况下记录完整的流程，然后在自动微分下重播选定的去噪步骤以及每个自回归单元的 KV 写入转换，同时保留整个流程中的完整历史计算图。 这使得来自后续自回归单元的梯度信号能够通过相连的历史 KV 状态在一次反向传播中传递。

paragraphs.en: For completed runs, peak device memory is the maximum sampled device-wide NVML memory.used on any GPU across all 50 iterations; allocated and reserved are maxima of per-step PyTorch peaks. Time is the slowest rank’s elapsed time from the end of iteration 5 through the end of iteration 50, divided by nine. Each five-iteration unit includes one generator and five fake-score updates. Table 5 reports the resulting single-GPU memory and per-five-iteration time, normalized to SF within each setting.
paragraphs.zh: 对于已完成运行的实验，峰值设备内存是指所有 50 次迭代中任意 GPU 上采样得到的 NVML memory.used 的最大值；而分配和保留内存则是每一步 PyTorch 峰值中的最大值。 时间是指最慢进程从第 5 次迭代结束到第 50 次迭代结束所经历的时间，再除以九。 每个包含五次迭代的单元包括一个生成器和五个虚假分数更新。 表 5 报告了由此得到的单 GPU 内存和每五次迭代的时间，并在每种设置中将其归一化为 SF。

paragraphs.en: In a separate chunk-wise diagnostic, direct Full BPTT with autograd enabled throughout the forward rollout reached 192.50 GiB. We therefore use replay-based Full BPTT as the more memory-efficient control in Table 5 : it shares the detached four-step rollout and selected-exit reconstruction with the other methods, yet retains all reconstructed historical connections until a single backward pass. The explicit replay cost is included in the reported time; gradient checkpointing is applied separately to all methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一个分块诊断中，在整个前向展开过程中启用 autograd 的直接完整 BPTT 达到了 192.50 GiB。 因此，我们在表 5 中使用基于重放的完整 BPTT 作为更节省内存的对照方法：它与其他方法共享解耦的四步展开和选中标记退出点的重建过程，但会将所有重建的历史连接保留到单次反向传播为止。 显式重放成本已包含在报告的时间中；梯度检查点则单独应用于所有方法。

paragraphs.en: To complement the long-horizon evaluations in the main paper, we further provide the full 16-dimensional VBench results (Table 6 ) for approximately 5-second chunk-wise generation under the same three initialization settings: Causal CD, TF, and Causal ODE. We additionally report Avg.(6), defined as the unweighted average of Aesthetic Quality, Background Consistency, Imaging Quality, Motion Smoothness, Subject Consistency, and Flickering.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充主论文中的长期评估，我们还进一步提供了完整的 16 维 VBench 结果（表 6），该结果基于约 5 秒的逐片段生成，并采用了相同的三种初始化设置：Causal CD、TF 和 Causal ODE。 此外，我们还报告了 Avg.(6)，其定义为美学质量、背景一致性、成像质量、运动流畅性、主体一致性和闪烁度的非加权平均值。

sents.en: To complement the long-horizon evaluations in the main paper, we further provide the full 16-dimensional VBench results (Table 6 ) for approximately 5-second chunk-wise generation under the same three initialization settings: Causal CD, TF, and Causal ODE.
sents.zh: 为了补充主论文中的长期评估，我们还进一步提供了完整的 16 维 VBench 结果（表 6），该结果基于约 5 秒的逐片段生成，并采用了相同的三种初始化设置：Causal CD、TF 和 Causal ODE。

sents.en: We additionally report Avg.(6), defined as the unweighted average of Aesthetic Quality, Background Consistency, Imaging Quality, Motion Smoothness, Subject Consistency, and Flickering.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还报告了 Avg.(6)，其定义为美学质量、背景一致性、成像质量、运动流畅性、主体一致性和闪烁度的非加权平均值。

paragraphs.en: Overall, SF, SGF, and CSF remain broadly comparable at this short horizon. CSF achieves the highest Avg.(6) under Causal CD and TF. Under Causal ODE, CSF remains closely matched with SF in Avg.(6). The individual VBench dimensions exhibit mixed rankings across methods rather than a uniform advantage for any single method. The six-metric average remains broadly comparable at short horizons, while individual semantic and compositional dimensions show setting-dependent trade-offs.

paragraphs.en: Figures 7 – 9 present additional comparisons among SF, SGF, and CSF. At 5 seconds, the three methods generally produce comparable visual quality, with only modest variations in subject appearance and local scene details. As the rollout extends to 60 seconds, longer-term drift becomes easier to observe: the appearance and composition of the subjects may gradually change, and in some cases the generated content departs more noticeably from the earlier part of the sequence. At 240 seconds, these effects become more apparent in examples involving articulated characters, human subjects, and animals, where subject identity, scale, and surrounding scene structure can evolve over time. In the examples shown, CSF tends to preserve the defining visual characteristics of the subject and the overall composition more steadily across the rollout. These qualitative results are intended to complement the long-horizon quantitative evaluation in the main paper.

paragraphs.en: To further evaluate CSF beyond chunk-wise autoregressive generation, we conduct additional frame-wise experiments. All methods are trained and evaluated with a matched nine-latent history window, consisting of three sink and six recent latents, comparable in scale to the chunk-wise setting. Training lasts 1,500 iterations, corresponding to 1,500 fake-score and 299 generator optimizer steps. The results therefore reflect this matched-cache setting rather than each baseline’s native configuration. All other settings follow the corresponding chunk-wise experiments unless otherwise specified.

paragraphs.en: We assess evaluation-sample uncertainty in Avg.(6) for the chunk-wise and frame-wise long-video settings reported above. paragraphs.en: CSF restores future-to-history gradient feedback without retaining the full autoregressive computation graph, but it does not aim to reproduce exact full-sequence backpropagation. In particular, Shortcut Gradient Replay selectively reconstructs paths to historical chunks, whereas Full BPTT connects the replayed computation across the autoregressive history. Its additional paths may give early chunks too much future feedback relative to direct DMD supervision. This suggests that the goal is not necessarily to propagate gradients through as much history as possible, but rather to provide useful future feedback while preserving a sufficiently strong local learning signal. This controlled comparison does not establish that full-history backpropagation is generally worse; further study is needed to understand when it helps. How to determine which historical states should receive gradient feedback, and from which future states, remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: CSF 无需保留完整的自回归计算图即可恢复未来到历史的梯度反馈，但它并不旨在完全重现完整的序列反向传播。 具体来说，Shortcut Gradient Replay 会选择性地重建通往历史分块的路径，而 Full BPTT 则会将重播的计算与自回归历史连接起来。 其额外的路径可能会使早期分块相对于直接的 DMD 监督获得过多的未来反馈。 这表明目标并不一定是要尽可能通过更长的历史传播梯度，而是提供有用的未来反馈，同时保留足够强的局部学习信号。 这种受控的比较并未证明完整历史反向传播总体上更差；需要进一步研究以了解它在何种情况下会有帮助。 如何确定哪些历史状态应接收梯度反馈，以及这些反馈来自哪些未来状态，仍然是一个开放性问题。

sents.zh: 这种受控的比较并未证明完整历史反向传播总体上更差；需要进一步研究以了解它在何种情况下会有帮助。

sents.en: How to determine which historical states should receive gradient feedback, and from which future states, remains an open question.
sents.zh: 如何确定哪些历史状态应接收梯度反馈，以及这些反馈来自哪些未来状态，仍然是一个开放性问题。

paragraphs.en: CSF trades memory consumption for additional computation through replay. Although the resulting training overhead remains practical in our post-training setting, replay becomes more expensive as the number of replayed historical states or writer dependencies grows. This may become more relevant for larger models or substantially longer autoregressive sequences. A natural direction is therefore to make historical gradient propagation more selective, for example through selective replay or sparse historical gradient assignment, so that gradients are propagated only through historical states that are most relevant to future generation. Such mechanisms could potentially retain the benefit of future-to-history feedback while reducing unnecessary recomputation and gradient interference.
paragraphs.zh: CSF 通过重播以额外的计算换取更高的内存消耗。 尽管在我们后训练设置中，由此产生的训练开销仍然在实际可接受范围内，但随着重播的历史状态数量或写入依赖项的增加，重播的成本也会随之上升。 对于更大的模型或明显更长的自回归序列而言，这一点可能变得更加重要。 因此，一个自然的思路是使历史梯度的传播更具选择性，例如通过选择性重播或稀疏的历史梯度分配，从而仅通过那些对未来生成最相关的历史状态来传播梯度。 这类机制有可能在保留从未来到历史的反馈优势的同时，减少不必要的重新计算和梯度干扰。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments also suggest a possible interaction between long-term consistency and temporal dynamics. In particular, removing components of the cross-chunk gradient that oppose the direct DMD gradient increases Dynamic Degree, while slightly reducing the aggregated quality and consistency metrics. This indicates that some future-to-history feedback may encourage more conservative temporal evolution rather than simply acting as harmful gradient conflict. Although CSF does not always achieve the highest Dynamic Degree in the current unconstrained generation setting, this trade-off may become less limiting in controllable generation or world-model settings, where motion and scene evolution are driven more explicitly by control signals, actions, or other external conditions. In such settings, CSF may be particularly useful for further reducing autoregressive error accumulation and preserving visual or state consistency over long horizons, while the desired dynamics are governed by the control input itself. Better understanding how future-to-history feedback should interact with controllable dynamics is therefore an interesting direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验还表明，长期一致性与时间动态之间可能存在相互作用。 具体来说，移除跨分块梯度中那些与直接 DMD 梯度相反的成分，会提高动态程度，同时略微降低聚合质量与一致性指标。 这表明，某些从未来到历史的反馈可能更倾向于促进保守的时间演化，而不仅仅是产生有害的梯度冲突。 尽管在当前无约束的生成设置中，CSF 并不总能实现最高的动态程度，但在可控生成或世界模型设置中，这种权衡可能变得不那么限制；在这些场景中，运动和场景演化更多由控制信号、动作或其他外部条件显式驱动。 在这样的设置中，CSF 可能特别有助于进一步减少自回归误差的累积，并在较长时间跨度内保持视觉或状态的一致性，而所需的动态特性则由控制输入本身决定。 因此，更好地理解未来到历史的反馈应当如何与可控动态相互作用，是未来研究的一个有趣方向。
